LanguageData.PhobosContract_InspectResting: {CARAVAN} is resting for the night; the work goes on in the morning.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_StartWorkDesc: Start the work {SETTLEMENT} asked for: {REQUEST}. The caravan stays while it is done, and its truck burns its own fuel. Leaving stops the work; what is done is kept.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_StopWorkDesc: Stop the work at {SETTLEMENT}. What is done is kept, for this caravan or another to finish before the contract runs out.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_ShortFluid: The caravan's tanks hold {HAVE} of the {WANT} {UNIT} of {FLUID} asked for.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_ShortThings: The caravan carries {HAVE} of what was asked for: {REQUEST}.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_NoVehicle: No vehicle in the caravan can do this work.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_NoHand: Nobody in the caravan is fit to do the work: it needs someone able in {SKILL}.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_NoHandAny: Nobody in the caravan is fit to tend the work.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_StoppedByOrder: The work at {SETTLEMENT} has stopped. What is done is kept.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_Left: {CARAVAN} has left {SETTLEMENT}, so the work there has stopped. What is done is kept.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_HeldUp: The work at {SETTLEMENT} is held up: {REASON}
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingContractFreq: Nearby settlements hire your vehicles: a load of chemfuel, water or stone, spare parts, or a truck's work at the settlement (a ground survey, a water bore, power for some days). The figure is how often, beside the game's own trade requests: 100% is as often as those, 0% offers none. A contract is offered only while you own a vehicle that can do it, and pays the game's usual quest rewards.
